policy: New Zealand is greenfield and has no incumbent population, so parity, export_surface, and target_surface are absent. Public NZ facts and Treasury oracles govern the build. MC15 weight quality follows the 2026-10-10 D1 ruling d1281: original-source household ESS at least 4000 and max/positive-median at most 5 block release; scenario-complete cell diagnostics are mandatory and failing cells are suppressed. Global ESS 16000 and the tighter cell support screen are tracked, never blocking. The 2026-10-12 d1376 ruling requires every selected calibration target within 5%, every demography target within 2%, and national/regional administrative anchors within 5%; incomplete target families remain release blockers; macro_realism waits on packaged evidence and reviewed bands. Donor support and release input coverage remain applicable and fail closed while their producers and checks are pending. Thresholds are never borrowed from another country or set from a candidate.

gates.notes: d1376, 2026-10-12; g8-method-addendum B7: every selected calibration target must be within 5%.
d1376, 2026-10-12; g8-method-addendum B7: every demography target must be within 2%.
d1376, 2026-10-12; g8-method-addendum B7: national and regional administrative anchors within 5%; use declared leaves or totals.

The generated G8-r1 cell-pinned Chronicle inventory declares active demography and tenure references with prepared-column bindings. Every activated reference must enter the matrix; parked statistical definitions, income contracts and receipt producers remain explicit release blockers.

The active national profile must retain every family of the D1 MC5 calibration set (target_references.json). Accommodation Supplement and Working for Families references are held out (holdout_references.json) and must never be required here. Treasury model outputs (DistributionExplorer, IncomeExplorer) and official Budget reform scores are validation oracles, never calibration targets.

R2C-3 (2026-11-02), frozen before any candidate run: the summed count and the summed amount over the coarse stand-in table's 12 bands each within 75-125% of the aged IRD comparator; refuse when 3 or more of the 12 bands have a count or an amount outside 50-200% (a band counts once); every band at least 30 distinct source households and source-household Kish ESS at least 30, for count and amount contributions separately; and the run's required evidence present by alias. R2C-18: only aliases a graph node really produces are wired into nz.gates.terminal, and none is yet, so the gate refuses every run as lacking evidence until G8-x wires them. A change to any number needs a new hub ruling first.

Authenticate the exact Build P donor artifact and close every declared Frame/Axiom input. A missing substantive root input of any module bound in axiom_rules_bindings.json is a build failure, never an engine default. allow_engine_optional is false: an engine default never closes an input here, and the gate names every engine-optional input it finds.

gates.notes: Every direct or derived calibration measure and every substantive Axiom input must carry a donor-support receipt. structural_columns lists the columns that carry identity or assignment (ruling H34): the seven columns CREATE synthesizes, the five donor identifier and pointer columns, and the geography columns the support walk reaches. Composition refuses a row whose column a value-carrying node owns, that a money roster declares, or whose concept is observed (ruling H44 D).

Household weights must receipt their design-to-calibrated transition and destination-population mass change. Family scoring resolves those weights through Frame; it may not persist a second ambiguous vector. The NZ hub set maximum_relative_mass_change to 0.02 (ruling H33): d1376 holds each of the 64 demography cells within 2% (demography_per_family_fit, within 0.02), and those cells split the population by 16 regions and four age bands from the same Stats NZ June 2025 estimates that set CREATE's mass. Region 99 (Chatham Islands) sits outside every cell: the national figure reads 5,324,700 and the 16 regions sum to 5,324,100 (reference_inventory.json erp_bridges), so cells within 2% bound the total within about 2.01%. This gate can therefore fail when every cell passes, but only when every cell sits at the limit and region 99 moves too. G8-x reports the measured change, and any later edit goes through review like the solver settings.
No all-zero stored calibration layer, substantive Axiom input, geography layer, or provenance banner may ship.
No Axiom-derived rule output may persist as an input column and mask a baseline or reform calculation.
The source manifest is authoritative for physically non-negative weights, counts, days, periods, care units, and currency inputs.
MC15 budget (b): Kish ESS on calibrated household weights summed by original source household, clones merged. The floor is an absolute count, independent of row count.
MC15 budget (b): max over positive median of original-source-aggregated calibrated household weights is at most 5, inclusive.

MC15: missing, malformed or scenario-incomplete source-household diagnostics block. MC15 suppresses cells below ESS 100, above contribution CV 2 or donor dollar share 10% and excludes them from reported output; proper suppression does not block. The classifier lists structural-zero cells separately. Subgroup rows report entitlement, without invented subgroup payment comparators. G8 addendum A2 explicitly expects structural-zero cells, and MC11's central exclude-and-count adds every variant: S0/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, S1/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, S2/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, S3/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, V1/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, V2/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, V3/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, V4/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, VHF/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, VSI/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, VEX/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant, VPT/beneficiary_superannuitant_other/superannuitant. S5 pays superannuitant units, so its cell is not structurally zero. The machine-readable list is reporting_classifiers.json structural_zero_cells; reported amounts determine actual structural-zero diagnostics.
MC15 target (a): report whether global original-source household ESS reaches 16000 on every build; never blocks release.
MC15 target (a): flag every cell with ESS at least 400 and maximum donor dollar share at most 5%; tracked on every build and never release-blocking.
